_meta.type: measurement -- decides whether the entry/exit layer gets rebuilt. Builds no new trade logic.
_meta.records_no_rebuild_recommendation: T5 describes the pictures; the rebuild call is Cooper's off these numbers.

population.what: v1-T0's gap-gated first-window entries (tick-exact gap-gate reconstruction, queued entries and next-tick fills, validated 6/6), with v2's snapped int64 tau_ns
population.tau: tau_ns -- the gap-gated entry TRIGGER instant, snapped back to its exact tick in v2-T1 after v1 wrote it as float64
population.coverage_statement: 903 of 15,763 D1 events = 5.7%, val split 2023-11-17 to 2024-07-22. NOT a measurement over D1.
population.why_this_population_not_v0s: v0's 1,027 ran with gap_gate_enabled = false and entry intraday_pct median +11.25% -- not the programme's +30% definition. The 903 are genuine crossers (move_at at entry median +36.0%).

e2_reuse.status: PARTIAL -- E2's baseline B_e is reused verbatim; E2's WINDOW artifact is NOT usable as an exit and is rebuilt. See rebuild_rationale.
e2_reuse.baseline_definition: mean DOLLAR volume per 10-minute RTH block over the available T-3/T-2/T-1 prior sessions, flat, no time-of-day matching. Verified in v0-T0: total_baseline_dollar_volume / B_e takes exactly the values 39/78/117 = n_baseline_sessions x 39 ten-minute RTH blocks.

why_not_reusable_as_an_exit: 443 of the 903 (49.1%) have its window_end_ts BEFORE the EPG entry tau -- an exit cannot precede its entry
40.75% of the 903 have duration_min == 0, i.e. participation 'ends' at t0 itself
window_end_ts - tau reaches 433,365 s = 5.0 days, so the window is not censored at the event-day extended session end, which the brief states is E2's own rule
the censored column is False on all 15,742 rows, which cannot be right if any censoring was applied
E2's brief, config and code were never committed -- only its artifacts -- so the declared C, the volume basis, and the censoring rule cannot be read from the repository
rebuild_rationale.what_was_done: participation_onset AND participation_end are both built here from event_minute_bars_v2 under the rule the brief states, with censoring at the event-day extended session end applied as the brief describes it. E2's B_e is reused unchanged. The divergence from E2's artifact is reported, not hidden.

participation_rule.source_series: event_minute_bars_v2, session_offset = 0 only (which is what enforces censoring at the event-day extended session end)
participation_rule.minute_dollar_volume: volume * vwap -- exact for a minute bar by the definition of VWAP
participation_rule.empty_minutes: a minute with no bar is a measured ZERO dollar volume, not a missing value. Zero and unavailable stay distinct: an event with no bars at all is unavailable and carried.
participation_rule.trailing_statistic: SUM of minute dollar volume over the trailing 10 minutes -- the quantity dimensionally comparable with B_e, which is itself a per-10-minute-block figure. The brief says 'trailing 10-minute average volume'; a per-minute average would be 10x smaller than B_e and the comparison would be meaningless.
participation_rule.participation_end: first minute after t0 where trailing-10-minute dollar volume <= 3 x B_e AND stays there for C consecutive minutes
participation_rule.participation_onset: the mirror, new in this run: first minute after t0 where trailing-10-minute dollar volume >= 3 x B_e AND stays there for C consecutive minutes
participation_rule.why_onset_matters: E2 assumes participation begins at t0 by fiat, so as written it cannot see late arrival -- which is the core of the hypothesis. The mirror rule costs nothing and is what makes the claim testable.

C_minutes.status: DECLARED HERE, NOT CARRIED FROM E2. The brief says 'C carried at E2's declared value'; that value is unrecoverable because E2's brief and code were never committed. 10 is a round choice equal to the trailing-window length. The ladder is reported as sensitivity on the headline numbers.
C_minutes.note: if E2's C is supplied it is a one-line change and a re-run

participation_rule.t0_source: results/fundamental_exploration/e2/artifacts/e2_d1_fundamentals.parquet t0_ns -- Build F1's tiered t0 (D33). 900 of the 903 resolve via minute_a102, 3 via nanosecond_poll1.

censoring.horizon: 20:00:00 America/New_York on the event day (session_offset = 0), the extended-session end
censoring.treatment: an event whose participation never decays before the horizon is CENSORED. Reported as its own class with its share stated, never pooled, no mean taken across censored and uncensored (E2 DE-3).
censoring.exit_for_censored: the last print at or before the censoring horizon. NOT silently treated as tradeable -- a session-end hold is a different risk from an intraday one under D5, and it is labelled as such.

exit_b_anchor.rule: first participation decay at or after tau
exit_b_anchor.why_not_the_t0_anchored_end: participation_end is measured after t0 because that is the participation FACT the overlay reports. An exit cannot precede its entry, so the tradeable Exit B uses the first decay at or after tau. Both quantities are reported and the share where they differ is stated.

B.name: participation decay
B.ts: first decay at or after tau, else the censoring horizon

exits.price_basis: BOTH exits priced tick-exactly from the event's own trades.parquet -- the last print at or before the exit timestamp. Using v1's tick price for A and a minute-bar price for B would compare two different bases.
exits.round_trips_note: extending a hold adds exposure, not a round trip. Each arm pays ONE round trip, so the cost comparison is the same single cost amortised over a longer move.

exact_labels.coverage: 100 events labelled, 18 halt-bearing; 73 of the 100 intersect the 903, of which 14 are halt-bearing. So exact labels cover 8.1% of this population.
exact_labels.provenance_note: produced by phase LULD-V3c's labeler after that phase's audit fixed two instrumentation bugs. The LULD exit LINE was abandoned 2026-06-20, but the halt LABELS are a measurement, not the abandoned exit.

proxy.rule: maximum inter-trade gap inside the hold interval exceeding 60 seconds
proxy.basis: declared, and the same 60 s figure scanner-epg-momentum/backtest/runner.py uses for its own halt-gap clock pause (EPG-Rapid C3)
proxy.status: A PROXY, labelled as such everywhere. A 60 s print gap in a name running thousands of prints per 10 minutes is almost certainly a halt, but the flag is a gap measurement and not a halt classifier.

constraints.d4: tick- or bar-derived from D4-clean sources only; event_minute_bars_v2 is Phase 6b's tick aggregate (D5 A11, reuse needs no citation)
constraints.e2_de2_de3: baseline-thin flagged and carried; censored reported as its own class with no mean taken across it
